question: I, J, K, L, U, V and W each have their exam on a different day of the week, starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. Only two people have their exam before V. Only one person has an exam after L. Only three people have an exam between V and I. Only one person has an exam between J and K. W has an exam just before J. Who among the following has an exam on Friday?
solution:
Given:

Seven people (I, J, K, L, U, V, W) have exams from Monday (1) to Sunday (7).

1) Only two people have their exam before V.

V's exam is on **Wednesday**.

2) Only one person has an exam after L.

L's exam is on **Saturday **

3) Only three people have an exam between V and I.
